chunks: And it is narrated from ʿAbd al-Ḥamīd ibn ʿAwwāḍ al-Ṭāʾī, who said:
I said to Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام: “Indeed, I have set up a mill in which is my sitting place, and in it my companions sit with me.”
He عليه السلام said: “That is the gentleness of Allah, Mighty and Majestic.”

key_terms.أَصْحَابِي: my companions or associates who sit with me
key_terms.اللَّهِ: Allah, the Divine source of mercy and facilitation
key_terms.رَحًى: a mill or grinding establishment used for livelihood
key_terms.مَجْلِسِي: my sitting place or regular place of gathering

ai.seo_question: How does Imam al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام describe a livelihood that also brings companions together?
ai.summary: This hadith presents the Imam عليه السلام approving a livelihood arrangement that also serves as a place of companionship and gathering. The statement identifies such ease and facilitation in earning and social benefit as a manifestation of Allah’s mercy and gentleness.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.3599 - It is narrated from Abdul-Hamid ibn 'Awad al-Ta'i who said:
I said to Abu Abdullah (as): "I have set up a millstone, and it is my sitting place where my companions also sit with me."
